tactics: intro α a l h; induction h with | head l => exact ⟨[], l, rfl⟩ | tail b _ ih => obtain ⟨s, t, rfl⟩ := ih; exact ⟨b :: s, t, rfl⟩
intro α a l h; exact List.mem_iff_append.mp h
intro α a l; induction l with | nil => simp | cons b l ih => intro h; simp at h; rcases h with rfl | h; exact ⟨[], l, rfl⟩; obtain ⟨s, t, rfl⟩ := ih h; exact ⟨b :: s, t, rfl⟩
